Pursuant to Standing Order 64(4), at 10:15 p.m. the Acting Speaker interrupted the 
proceedings, and the debate adjourned. 
Committee of the Whole 
According to Order, the Assembly resolved itself into Committee of the Whole and the 
Acting Speaker left the Chair. 
(Assembly in Committee) 
Pursuant to Standing Order 64(4), at 10:15 p.m. the Deputy Chair immediately put the 
question on the Appropriation Bills standing on the Order Paper referred to Committee 
of the Whole. 
The question was put on the approval of Bill 7, Appropriation Act, 2022 ($), and Bill 8, 
Appropriation (Supplementary Supply) Act, 2022 ($), which was agreed to. With 
Mr. Milliken at the Table, the names being called for were taken as follows: 
For the motion:  27 
Aheer Long Rehn 
Allard Luan Rowswell 
Amery Madu Sawhney 
Copping Neudorf Schow 
Ellis Nicolaides Sigurdson 
(Highwood) 
Issik Nixon (Calgary-Klein) Singh 
Jones Nixon (Rimbey-Rocky Mtn. House-Sundre) Toews 
Kenney Orr Walker 
LaGrange Panda Williams 
Against the motion:  7 
Ceci Irwin Pancholi 
Deol Nielsen Shepherd 
Ganley 
The Acting Speaker resumed the Chair. 
The following Bills were reported: 
Bill 7 Appropriation Act, 2022 ($) — Hon. Mr. Toews 
Bill 8 Appropriation (Supplementary Supply) Act, 2022 ($) — Hon. Mr. Toews
